newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania condemns Serbian authorities for violence.
newsitem.headline: Romania condemns Serbian authorities for violence.

text.p: Romania on Wednesday condemned the Serbian authorities' use of violence against opposition protesters in Belgrade and asked them to show restraint in settling the conflict.
"Romania's government condemns the violence...deplores the situation and hopes for a fast and democratic settlement of the conflict," a government statement said.

Serbian riot police fired tear gas and used batons against opposition supporters in the centre of Belgrade on Tuesday after Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic addressed a rally of his followers. Scores were injured in the clashes.
Romanian President Emil Constantinescu also voiced concern over the events in the neighbouring country.

A statement from the president's office said Constantinescu had learned with "consternation about the conflicts between the (Serbian) government and the opposition which now have reached a dangerous phase".
Constantinescu called on Belgrade to refrain from escalating the violence. "We ask the Serbian authorities to show wisdom and not to resort to force," the statement said.
